shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs to Conquer Boom Beach 🏝️💥
shortIntro.para1: Boom Beach might look like a sunny paradise, but it’s a tactical battlefield where split-second decisions win or lose wars. From deploying troops to firing mortars, your device needs to keep up with every command.
shortIntro.para2: Slow loading or laggy animations can turn a perfect assault into a hilarious defeat 😅. A capable CPU, steady RAM, and a reliable network connection make every attack feel satisfying.

intro: Here’s the ultimate rundown of minimum and recommended specs for Boom Beach on Android and iOS — whether you’re casually attacking islands or running a full-on archipelago empire 😎🏝️.

minimum.GPU: Basic mobile GPU (Boom Beach is highly optimized)
minimum.Internet: Stable connection required for online attacks 🌐

recommended.RAM: 4GB+ for smoother base loading and faster combat 💨
recommended.Storage: 3GB+ to handle events, heroes, and updates
recommended.Internet: Strong Wi-Fi or 4G/5G – because lag kills dreams 🚀

ios_intro: Boom Beach is a joy on iOS 🍏. Even older iPhones can handle island battles with minimal hiccups thanks to Supercell’s optimization wizardry.
fps_intro: FPS isn’t everything in Boom Beach, but smoother gameplay improves troop movement, animations, and your tactical precision 🎯.

fps_list.fps: 30 FPS (playable, tactical moves may feel slightly delayed 😌)

storageIntroText: Boom Beach isn’t massive, but updates and events grow over time. Make sure your device has some breathing room 📦.
faqIntroText: Boom Beach FAQs – conquer islands smarter, not harder 😎:

faqList.question: Is Boom Beach heavy on phones?
faqList.answer: Not at all 👍. Supercell optimized it well; even older or budget devices run it smoothly.

faqList.question: Do I need high FPS for Boom Beach?
faqList.answer: Stable FPS matters more than max FPS. Tactical decisions outweigh frame rates here.

faqList.question: Why does my game lag sometimes?
faqList.answer: Most lag comes from weak internet or background apps. Close extras and check connection 🌐.
